preconditions: CR, license and plant identifiers exist or return a controlled no-result state
steps: Search CR; search license; search plant; open parent CR; verify selected license/plant
expected_result: Each identifier resolves to the correct CR and selected context

steps: Open CR; switch license; observe all dependent sections
expected_result: Selected license changes without leaving Factory 360 and every section refreshes

preconditions: CR has one or more licenses
steps: Open CR overview; inspect portfolio aggregates
expected_result: No CR-level risk score or compliance rate is calculated

steps: Open every section; attempt direct and UI mutation
expected_result: No Factory 360 write succeeds and no editing control is exposed

preconditions: Source metadata exists, is stale, or is unavailable
steps: Open source/freshness panel; inspect latest sync and degraded states
expected_result: Source, timestamp, freshness fact and failure are truthful

steps: Load product; raw-material; spare-part; machine; search and paginate
expected_result: All four documented types retain quantities, mappings, bilingual labels and history

steps: Open every absent-contract section
expected_result: Typed unavailable state uses SENAEI_API_CONTRACT_NOT_SUPPLIED and invents no data

preconditions: Official and approved observed snapshots differ
steps: Open comparison; inspect source/date/inspection link
expected_result: Official master data and immutable observed facts are distinct and traceable

steps: Open selected license; calculate eligible answered scored items
expected_result: Displayed rate uses only latest approved immutable submission and exact exclusions

preconditions: Approved, returned and rejected reports exist
steps: Open report list and trend; compare inclusion
expected_result: Returned/rejected remain visible but do not affect rate/trend

steps: Open report; inspect latest and version history
expected_result: Latest version is listed and all immutable versions are accessible

preconditions: Approved inspection has historical violations and penalties
steps: Open violation; inspect active and historical penalties
expected_result: Each violation links to one approved inspection and has at most one active penalty

preconditions: Stored risk snapshots and factors exist
steps: Open risk history and explanation
expected_result: History is source-backed and explanation references saved Risk Engine outputs only

steps: Open grouped documents/images and inspection evidence
expected_result: Business groups are correct and inspection evidence remains linked, never merged

steps: Preview as viewer; download with/without permission
expected_result: Preview/download enforce distinct permissions and denial leaks no content

steps: Request OCR; inspect append-only result and source context
expected_result: OCR is advisory, contextual, append-only and never changes authoritative data

steps: Open map from selected context

steps: Launch Create Inspection
expected_result: Planning opens prefilled context and no visit is created directly

steps: Export as multiple personas; inspect content and metadata
expected_result: PDF includes only permitted source-backed sections and generation context

steps: Open page; inspect failed and healthy sections; retry
